name: com.taglendinggroup/agent-api
title: TAG Lending Group
description: Public facts about TAG Lending Group: licensed states, contact info and loan program page links.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Use to answer who TAG Lending Group is. Returns legal name, NMLS number, company type, city and the audience it serves (MLOs, brokers, Realtors, investors). Public facts only.

tools.name: get_licensing
tools.description: Use to check where TAG can do business. Returns the states where TAG is a lender and the states where it is a mortgage broker only. Never returns rates or eligibility decisions.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Use when a user wants to reach TAG. Returns the public office address, main phone number and office hours. Contains no individual or borrower contact data.

tools.name: list_loan_program_pages
tools.description: Use to find TAG loan program pages. Returns program names with links to the public pages (supports limit and cursor). Never returns rates, pricing or eligibility.
